## What is the Best Zoom Alternative?

The best alternative will depend on your budget, the level of daily team collaboration, and whether your workforce is fully remote, in-house, or blended.

Our picks for the best alternatives to Zoom Meetings are:

### Best Overall: Cisco Webex

Cisco Webex is the best Zoom Meetings alternative because it offers robust free and paid plans, lets teams host up to 1,000 video meeting participants, and includes excellent attendee engagement features like advanced in-meeting polls, multi-lingual interpretations, whiteboarding, and People Insights.

Like Zoom One, Webex users can choose to scale up to a combined VoIP phone system and web conferencing tool with Webex Suite Plans.

### Best Free Alternative: Microsoft Teams [...] ### Nextiva

Nextiva is a Zoom alternative for businesses that want video meetings built into the same platform as their phone system, team messaging, and SMS.

Video meetings support up to 25 active video participants, with up to 250 people able to join by audio. Guests can join from a browser without creating an account or downloading an app, while hosts get the essentials for everyday meetings, including screen sharing, recording, co-hosts, and Google Calendar and Outlook integrations.

Compared with Zoom, Nextiva is less suited to large video meetings, webinars, and events. However, its advantage is the consolidation of the business phone, messaging, and meeting tools in one platform.

#### Top Features [...] VoIP calling and team chat is included and equipped with AI-powered background noise reduction. Up to 200 video participants can take place in meetings that can run to 24 hours with breakout rooms and live meeting reactions. It’s a best-fit for SMBs that are growing into using more UCaaS.

### Best for Google Workspace: Google Meet

Google Meet is a powerful Zoom alternative for teams already using Google Drive, Docs, Gmail, and Calendar. Meet does not require any downloads and can be used natively through a browser, it is lightweight, fast, and designed for seamless access.
